name: ATM Configuration Parameter 2
definition: Parameters to be used by the various cryptographic key commands.

HostChallenge.name: Host Challenge
HostChallenge.definition: Random value from the host provided during a previous exchange.

Certificate.name: Certificate
Certificate.definition: Ordered certificate chain of the asymmetric key encryption key, starting with the host certificate.

KeyProperties.name: Key Properties
KeyProperties.definition: Cryptographic key involved in the security command.
